**Building from scratch for GW1 — captain Haaland and don't overthink it.**

**✅ What's strong**
This 5-3-2 build projects a tasty 60.93 pts from the XI at exactly £100.0m. Haaland is the obvious armband — nailed, on pens, and packing 0.86 xGI/90. B.Fernandes (7.44 xP) is the standout midfield engine on pens and free-kicks, while Enzo at £7.0m offers premium output at a tidy price. At the back, Virgil (6.33 xP) brings clean-sheet security plus a soft run. No fitness flags to worry about this week — clean bill of health.

**🔄 What I'd change**
Building from scratch, prioritise the spine: Haaland up top, Fernandes and Enzo in midfield, Virgil anchoring defence. Pair Haaland with Watkins (5.3 xP) or João Pedro for a strong front two. For value, Enzo at £7.0m and Hume at just £4.5m (4.86 xP) are the smart budget-enablers. Le Fée at £6.0m is a cheeky differential with set-piece upside.

**Bottom line:** Load up on the nailed premiums, back Haaland with the captaincy, and roll into GW1 with 60-plus points in the tank.
